text:
Elaine: Quick sync — starting the quarterly least-privilege sweep next Tue. Need volunteers to own a KMS/admin-role canary and an RBAC sampling pass. Link to checklist: https://redwood.internal/sops/kms-perms

Kamal: I can take the KMS canary. Plan: sample ~20 service accounts across prod/staging, remove admin role in staging first, run smoke + CI checks, then roll to prod if green. Need a clear rollback path.

Mike: Heads-up: removing roles has historically broken CI for some infra svc accts. Can we add a temporary bypass or a short-lived allowlist for pipeline service accounts during the canary? Also ensure audit logs forwarding is on. :warning:

Jess: +1. I'll own outreach to product owners for exceptions and approvals. To detect silent failures we should alert on auth-failure spikes (suggest threshold 0.5% over 15m).

access-review-bot: Automated report: found 48 identities with "KMSAdmin" in prod, 12 with no owner assigned. Report: https://redwood.internal/reports/kms-admins-q2

infra-oncall: If CI flakes, we should have a documented quick-fix: re-add role, requeue job, and file trace for the svc acct. Also add a --dry-run flag to the role-removal script so we can preview impacts. (reacted with :eyes:)

Kamal: Example commands I'm using to enumerate bindings (AWS examples):
```
# list key policy for an alias
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/my-key --policy-name default | jq .

# check principal binds across keys (pseudo)
aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[].KeyId' | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id {}
```
We'll also export a CSV for sampling owners.

Elaine: Draft runbook items please: steps to remove, smoke tests, owners to notify, rollback. Timeline: start canary Wed 09:00 PT, evaluate Thu 13:00 PT, escalate to SRE/security on failures.

Mike: I'll add an allowlist for the CI service account (sa-ci@redwood) for the canary window and enable verbose auth logging to the security-bucket. Will also add CloudTrail/Audit forwarding check in the pre-flight.

Jess: I'll create the owner outreach sheet and tag product teams. Adding a quick form for approval exceptions.

Kamal: Creating the canary PR now — will include dry-run mode, logging toggles, and explicit rollback steps. Tagging @infra-oncall and @Jess for review.

Elaine: :thumbsup: Thanks team. Dropping the kickoff doc here: https://redwood.internal/docs/rbac-sweep-kickoff. Please add any blockers to the PR.

Mike: One more ask — can we also snapshot current IAM bindings (export) and upload to the audit bucket before changes? That made triage much faster last time.

Kamal: Good call. I'll add an `export-bindings` step in the PR.

Elaine: Great. We'll reconvene Fri if anything unexpected pops up.
